Maria G.: Heads-up — starting Zephyr20b safetensors conversion + onboarding. Source dir: s3://redwood-models/zephyr20b/v1/weights/ (originals are sharded .pt). Need quick sanity checks before serve: tokenizer vocab_size, shard naming/layout, fp16 vs bf16 flag, and KV cache ordering. Anyone free to help async?
Kevin L.: I kicked off a conversion test (local). Found config.json vocab_size: 50256 but tokenizer.json has 50257. Also saw BOS token id mismatch (config says 1, tokenizer says 2). Posting snippet: ```json
{"vocab_size":50256,"bos_token_id":1} ```
Sasha R.: Yep that off-by-one is expected — tokenizer package keeps an extra padding token. We need to run the remap script before packing embeddings: `scripts/remap_tokenizer_offsets.py --shift 1`. Also confirm sentencepiece normalizer vs huggingface config.
Infra-bot: checksum scanner: shard_000.safetensors OK (sha256: b94f6f...), shard_001.safetensors OK — uploaded to s3://redwood-models/zephyr20b/v1/weights/ at 2026-03-17T10:45:12Z
Elaine P.: Quick question — serving config: do we require tensor-parallel=4 for Zephyr20b or can we serve with TP=2 + fallback? Need to know for staging allocation. Also any KV cache ordering notes?
Tony H.: Please run `./tools/validate_weights.sh --model zephyr20b --weights s3://redwood-models/zephyr20b/v1/weights/ --expect-tp 4` from dev machine. That will lint sharding, shapes and dtype headers.
Maria G.: Thanks — I'll run validate_weights.sh now with --dtype fp16. Planning to pack as safetensors (`convert_to_safetensors.py --dtype fp16 --shard-layout p4`) and then run small generation smoke test. Can someone review the conversion CR?
Kevin L.: I can review. A couple of checklist items: 1) ensure safetensors metadata includes `tp_layout` and `orig_dtype`, 2) shard filenames follow convention `zephyr_v1_p{tp}_r{rank}.safetensors`, 3) include per-shard sha256 in meta.json. Docs: https://internal.redwood.dev/model-packaging/shard-format (link).
Sasha R.: Edge case I hit earlier: tokenizer had two trailing special tokens so embeddings array ended up one index shorter. Quick inspector: ```python
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
t = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json')
print(t.get_vocab_size())
```
If vocab mismatch, run `python tools/fix_tokenizer_padding.py --tokenizer tokenizer.json --expected 50257`
Infra-bot: object upload complete. s3://redwood-models/zephyr20b/v1/weights/ shard count=8 total=31.2GB.
Elaine P.: I'll take serve smoke on dedicated-staging once you post the final packed artifacts + model config. Please confirm `max_seq_len` (client wants 8192), `rotary_pct` and `kv_cache_order` fields.
Maria G.: Test plan (short): 1) validate_weights.sh -> pass; 2) pack safetensors p4 fp16; 3) run `serve-smoke --model-path ./packed/zephyr_v1_p4_r0.safetensors --seq 128` -> expect reply under 250ms on staging dGPU; 4) verify tokenizer roundtrip for 50 prompts. I'll post logs and checksums here.
Kevin L.: Also include the conversion log with `--log-level debug` and `--preserve-weights-map` so we can audit layout. I'll review the CR after you push.
Tony H.: ping @Sasha R. can you run the tokenizer roundtrip for 50 prompts and paste the failure cases?
Sasha R.: on it, starting now. I'll paste any failing tokens as short list.
Maria G.: Uploaded packed artifacts to s3://redwood-models/zephyr20b/v1/packed/ with meta.json. SHA256 meta: `a3c9...f1b2`. Running smoke tests next.
Kevin L.: :thumbsup: will do quick audit.
Tony H.: :eyes: awaiting smoke results.
Maria G.: Smoke results — generation OK, latency median 210ms on staging, tokenizer roundtrip 50/50 passes, 2 fails (listed below). Fail cases: token id 50255 decoded -> unknown char sequence. Root cause: tokenizer padding token not present in embeddings. Fix applied with remap script and repack.
Sasha R.: re-run roundtrip after remap -> all good. Pushing note to CR.
Maria G.: All green now. Thanks everyone. I'll mark onboarding ticket #ML-487 as ready for canary.
Kevin L.: Great. I'll merge the conversion CR and add a follow-up to add a unit test for tokenizer offset.
Tony H.: Closing the loop on deploy scheduling. I'll book staging window for tomorrow. :party:
